_readme: Livestream channels for the 'Live Streams' tab (see js/streams.js). No longer gated behind a live basho (see that file's header comment) — every enabled entry always renders, live or not.

Schema per entry: { id, platform, label, channelUrl, channelId (youtube) | channelName (twitch) | embedUrl (generic), assumeLive, category, contentType, official, language, status, communityRank, disabled, note }.
platform: "youtube" — channelId is the UC... ID; live status is checked automatically via YouTube's public oEmbed endpoint, no manual toggling needed.
platform: "twitch"  — channelName is the twitch.tv/<name> username. No public keyless live-status API, so "assumeLive" controls the live/offline card by hand.
platform: "generic" — embedUrl is a full iframe embed URL for some other embeddable player. Same limitation/toggle as Twitch.

category/contentType/official/language/status/communityRank mirror data/videos.json's schema — see that file's _readme for what each means. status "Historical" is hidden by default (Settings > Show inactive channels reveals it), same as videos.json.
disabled: true is a hard, non-toggleable gate for unverified/non-embeddable entries — separate from the status-based show/hide.

On every load, js/streams.js pings each enabled YouTube entry the same CORS-friendly, keyless way it already checks live status, so a taken-down YouTube channel gets hidden automatically rather than sitting there broken. Twitch/generic entries have no equivalent public check and still need periodic manual review.

Twitch channel names/YouTube channelIds below were either confirmed directly (creator video descriptions, channel About pages) while building this feature, or supplied by the site owner's own researched CSV list — see individual notes for which.
